existing_infrastructure: toxicity_proxy (computed from ob_spread + ob_imbalance in feature_intelligence/service.py)

detectors.detect_sweep: Large price sweep with volume spike; honours sweep_up_detected/sweep_down_detected flags
detectors.detect_spoof_wall_pull: Spoof/wall pull from spoof_detected flag or spoof_score > 0.65
detectors.detect_liquidity_hunt: High liquidation count (5m), proximity to liquidation clusters, or flag
detectors.detect_depth_tape_divergence: depth_vs_tape_divergence feature, or derived from ob_imbalance vs taker_buy_ratio
detectors.detect_toxic_flow: toxicity_proxy > 0.65, or high order_flow_imbalance; uses existing feature pipeline
detectors.detect_stop_run_risk: stop_run_risk_score, or 2+ of: large wick, round-number touch, liq burst 1m

actions.ENTRY_BLOCK: Block new entries when detector fires
actions.EXIT_ACCELERATE: Accelerate exit on open position when detector fires
actions.SIZE_REDUCE: Reduce position sizing when detector fires

invariants.fail_safe: All detectors return detected=False when data is missing

fixes_applied.detail: Runs all 6 detectors, combines entry_blocked/exit_accelerated/size_reduced signals. Returns per-detector dict.

wiring_note: Detectors are implemented as pure functions. Wiring into paper_online_runtime.py entry/exit path is a follow-on task (Phase 10 wiring checklist). feature_family_classifier.py already classifies sweep_spoof_wall family (Phase 2).
